record.text: Luka Garza’s corner three is just the second the Celtics have managed to hit (in 16 attempts) so far.

More movement from the Boston Celtics. Notice Garza starts in the left corner and the ball gets advanced to him. Pritchard from the right corner off three screens into a handoff. Left side is clear, no show on the handoff so help is forced.
Celtics with 12 more shots than Orlando in a quarter is wild.

Celtics secure a lead after the 1Q despite shooting 9.1% from 3 while the Magic have shot 50%. 

It helps a lot that the Celtics are -6 in TOs and +11 in FGAs
Celtics getting massively out-gunned percentage-wise, but lead after 1 qtr due to forcing so many turnovers.

End of the 1st quarter: Celtics 24, #Magic 23

Orlando shot 6 of 12 from 3-point range and held Boston to 1 for 11 from distance.

But the Celtics outscored Orlando 16-4 in the paint, grabbed 5 offensive boards and forced 8 turnovers.

The #Magic's offense is getting good looks and generally humming, shooting 6-for-12 from deep and 8-for-15 overall. But eight turnovers are giving the #Celtics life. Plenty of offensive rebounds too.

#Magic trail the #Celtics 24-23 after one quarter.
